Replaces the Prosseda/Universal Music album upload with an original concert source. The uploader supplies individual prelude and fugue chapter times. analysis.description: Opening subject and answer entries only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Saayman's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The excerpt covers mm. 1–28, including the redundant bass entry identified by Saayman. The fourteen-quarter-note core ends after the second longer-note gesture; subsequent tails are extensions. The alto's cross-staff notation does not make it a bass entry. Manual reading of the public-domain score, corroborated by Saayman's discussion of entry order and subject design. Quarter-note coordinates are relative to each fugue, not to its prelude. Only the opening exposition is mapped. Entry endpoints mark the subject core; continuing counterpoint and extensions are not automatically included.
